# Field equipment directory

The depot hires field instruments by the day. Users compare the instrument, depot and daily rate, inspect a record, and toggle its inclusion in a pick list. The supplied inventory is fictional.

Use the pale grey-green paper, near-white working surface, dark green ink and deep green action colour in `directory.css`. Keep the Georgia title and Segoe UI controls. Depot names, inventory identifiers, hire rates and pick state are always readable. Inspect updates the live detail line; Pick toggles only the chosen instrument. The inventory pane scrolls within the window.
